title: India-Native Alpha Feature Engine & Feature Governance — Quality Report

feature_inventory.note_on_promotion: All 109 active features are classified RESEARCH. No features are PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE because no OOS IC experiment has been run on real Indian equity data. This is the correct starting state; promotion requires OOS stability evidence.

leakage_audit.unclassified_note: 10 UNCLASSIFIED findings are patterns in test files and non-feature utility code. None are in feature computation paths.

finding.rationale: fillna(0) on the Accumulation/Distribution MF multiplier. When HL range = 0 (doji bar), the CLV is undefined; zero is the neutral/no-information value. Economically defensible.

fixes.old: NaN→0.0 global sweep in compute_stock_features() and compute_regime_features()
fixes.new: Only inf removed; NaN preserved as DATA_UNAVAILABLE

fixes.old: feats.get(f, 0.0) for all 4 model feature lists

sources_unavailable: nse_options (IV history, PCR, max pain, OI walls)
data_availability.note: All 38 features with unavailable sources correctly return NaN / None with DATA_UNAVAILABLE status. No fabrication.

known_limitations: 109 active features are RESEARCH state — none are PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE. Promotion requires OOS IC evidence on real Indian equity data.
talib not installed in test environment — 26 talib-dependent features cannot be verified in this env; they are tested via the talib-free families/momentum.py reference implementations.
No real dataset loaded — all quality statistics (missingness, constant features, redundancy) are from synthetic data only. Real-data quality analysis deferred.
F&O / derivatives features (PCR, IV, OI) are DATA_UNAVAILABLE offline — 38 features cannot be exercised without live NSE data feed.
Cross-sectional and breadth features require historical_universe(t) — this is correctly gated on the Phase 3B HistoricalUniverse; offline tests use mock data.
OOS IC / Rank IC not computed — no real data available. Deferred to Phase 3E.
Sector membership PIT correctness depends on the sector_master data store (Phase 3B). Offline: sector features return NaN.
